description: Minor material amendments (S.73) to vary, delete or add conditions in relation to condition no. 2 (Approved Plans), 5 (landscaping), 7 (Cycle Parking Spaces), 10 (Foundation Method Statement), 11 (Remediation), 13 (Drainage Strategy), 14 (Piling Method Statement),15 (Refuse and Recycling), 16 (Noise Mitigation Measures), 17 (Insultation Measures - commercial), 18 (Sound Level Rating - External Plant), 19 (Masts, Antennae & Satellite Dishes), 21 (Flood Risk Assessment),  25 (Business Hours), 26 (Commercial Units Use Class), 27 (Bat Survey Report), 28 (BREEAM), 29 (Energy Strategy), 31 (Dwelling Energy Performance Certificates), 32 (Commercial Spaces Energy Performance Certificates), 33 (Children's Play Space), 36 (Fire Statement) and 37 (Wind Assessment) and the creation of new conditions nos. 38 (Anti Vibration Mounts), 39 (Airbourne Noise Sources), 40 (Seperation between flats) and 41 (Lifts and Risers) pursuant to planning permission reference 171721FUL dated 02.02.2018 as varied by 203596NMA dated 17.09.2020 and pursuant to 213744VAR dated 08.12.2021 for 'Construction of buildings comprising residential units (Use Class C3), flexible retail space (Use Class A1/A2) (at ground floor of the building fronting Northfield Avenue), office space (Use Class B1) (at ground and lower ground of the building fronting Northfield Avenue), landscaping, access and servicing, car parking and associated works (following demolition of existing buildings).' Variation seeks four additional residential units; reduction in non-residential floorspace; decreasing the height of Block A (from 8 storeys to 6 storeys) and increasing the height of Block C from (from 3 and 4 storeys to 4 and 5 storeys); internal alterations to allow for sprinkler tank infrastructure; amendments to the car and cycle parking provision; other associated access and landscape works and varying the legal obligation.
